notes.title: Patch Update July 11th 2025
notes.content:
A multitude of fixes, adjustments and polish toward this game's refinement.

Many small issues player's may have encountered have been fixed and more.

notes.title: Manic Update
notes.content:
Updated with a ton of new content and features over the last few years. The polish continues.

-Small tweaks to various things here and there throughout the world

-Changed the Victim's hallucination follower NPC's behaviors and collisions

-Removed a useless info page

-Updated Author page

-Fixed door bugs when playing as the male character

-Fixed bugged maggots when playing as the male character

-Fixed Death Cutscene when captured by the Death Creature when playing as the male character


Also, since release:
Check all prior game updates to see more.

notes.title: Tender Loving Care (TLC) Update
notes.content:
Happy Mask Game Version Update 2.0+ Only Available for the Windows OS

-Added 14 New Steam Achievements

-Added a Character Select Option that consists of a Male version and a Female version with differentiated control

-Reworked and optimized the logic under the hood to accommodate the Character Select Option

-Added and reworked Cutscenes to coincide with each Character

-Added a bunch of NPCs and placed them around the world

-Added a Reload game option in the Pause Menu

-Added to the Beginning of the Game's Introduction Cutscenes

-Replaced all of the Commadore Option Select Graphic Images

-Replaced the Game Over Screen

-Added four new follower NPCs that may or may not follow the player while exploration and may or may not say something strange

-Added a guide NPC to assist within the early game's purgatory maze to reduce player confusion.

-Now the Brick attack to shoots in the direction the player is facing and at a lower angle. Instead of the prior intrinsic precision mechanic which is now gone.

-Adjusted the Murder Crow threat to behave in a better hit and run way, rather than the prior thrashing of claws and wings.

-Adjusted the Doll Face threat and removed it's prior movement pattern and replaced it with a wave type movement function that moves toward and faces the direction of the player.

-Replaced some of the prior Background Gradients

-Replaced all text prompts with sprites and replaced the prior in game font to match all in game text 

-Replaced the eyes threats and ghost threat sprites with new sprites.

-Replaced most of the tree sprites with new sprites.

-Replaced most of the menu selection sprites

-Replaced a bunch of Backgrounds with newer versions

-Adjusted Ladders in the sewer area.

-Updated all of the Game's Steam Achievement icons and added one new achievement.

-Replaced a ton of menu sprites with refined cohesive sprite style to fit in more with the aesthetics.

-Replaced the control page menu back.

-replaced the sprites that did not mesh with the aesthetics with newer more fitting sprites.

-Fixed the Ladder positions on the left side wall of the First Place of Deception Tower.

-Fixed a bug in the Place of Deception where the wrong husk spawned toward solving a puzzle after the initial husk disintegrated and forced the player to solve the puzzle first try.
This has been corrected to spawn the correct husk after each initial husk dissolves.

-Added backgrounds to a few in-game and menu screens

-Added a few new SFX

-Adjusted some layering in the Brain Function Menu screen

-and more+

notes.title: Happy Mask Navigation Map Update
notes.content:
Game Version 1.0.2.0

Added navigation Map that has multiple forms, layers and features.
It displays the player's coordinates for an Expanded full Map View & a Zoomed in View combed over 1000 separate rooms within 24 Unique Ares within 16 individualized Map Segments that make up the World Map.

Also
-added cooldown icons for usable overworld item functions
-added New Sprites, Sound Effects, Collectable Map Items
-added more polish and "under the hood" adjustments
-Resolved Cloud Save Issue
